question: A hemispherical bowl made of brass has an inner radius 3.5 cm. Find the cost of tin plating it on the inside at the rate of ₹4 per cm².
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total cost for inner plating = Inner Curved Surface Area × Rate per cm²

Cost = 2πr² × Rate

Cost = 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5 × 4

Cost = (44/7) × 12.25 × 4 = 77 × 4 = ₹308

**∴ The correct answer is ₹308.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Inner radius of the hemispherical bowl (r) = 3.5 cm

Rate of tin plating = ₹4 per cm²

**Formula Used:**

Inner Surface Area of a hemisphere = 2πr²

Total Cost = Inner Surface Area × Rate

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
• 
 r = 3.5 cm
 

 Inside Plating @ ₹4 / cm²
 Inner Surface Area = 2πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Inner Surface Area = 2 × (22/7) × (3.5)²

⇒ Inner Surface Area = 2 × (22/7) × 12.25

⇒ Inner Surface Area = 44 × 1.75 = 77 cm²

⇒ Total Cost = 77 × 4

⇒ Total Cost = ₹308

**∴ The correct answer is ₹308.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

It includes the curved surface area and the flat circular base area. Formula: TSA = 3πr²

Volume of a Hemisphere

It is exactly half the volume of a full sphere. Formula: Volume = (2/3)πr³

Surface Area of a Full Sphere

A full sphere has only one continuous curved surface. Formula: Surface Area = 4πr²
